bundle.shortDescription: Set up and run sdkck plugins
bundle.longDescription: sdkck Desktop is a native companion to the sdkck CLI: it installs sdkck, manages its plugins, and lets you browse, search and run every command — including imported APIs and MCP tools — from a fast, form-based UI.
